promoteFeedback.title: Meaningful moments
promoteFeedback.description: Genuine words from our beloved customers wearing our traditional creations.

1.name: Mai Anh Le
1.content: The burgundy lotus-embroidered wedding Ao Dai made me so proud on my big day. Every hand-stitched detail was exquisite and it fit like a glove.

2.name: Minh Thu
2.content: I ordered a mulberry silk Ao Dai for a foreign partner meeting. Everyone praised the elegant silhouette and the breathable, crease-resistant silk.

3.name: Oanh Nguyen
3.content: The modern collection this season is highly creative with pastel hues, combining contemporary design with traditional Vietnamese modesty.

4.name: Quynh Chi
4.content: I buy Tet Ao Dai here for my whole family every year. The brocade fabric is thick and premium, with beautiful subtle woven patterns.

5.name: Elizabeth Smith
5.content: The custom tailoring service was incredible! Even with my tight travel schedule, they delivered a perfectly fitted, beautifully embroidered gown.

6.name: Thu Trang Tran
6.content: Wearing this to teach all day is extremely comfortable. The fabric is highly breathable, the stitching is durable, and the colors stay brand new.

craftStory.eyebrow: The journey of an Ao Dai
craftStory.title: From silk thread to gown
craftStory.description: Every Ao Dai goes through three handcrafted stages over 5 to 7 days.

1.label: Fabric
1.title: Choosing silk and brocade
1.content: Mulberry silk and brocade are sourced from long-standing weaving villages and checked for softness, drape and colour in natural light before cutting.

2.label: Embroidery
2.title: Hand-embroidered motifs
2.content: Artisans stitch every lotus petal and apricot branch in metallic thread. A fully embroidered bodice can take up to 40 hours.

3.label: Tailoring
3.title: A silhouette of your own
3.content: Each gown is cut to 12 body measurements, then fitted and adjusted so it hugs the body yet flows gracefully as you walk.
